answer: Sybils fail when identity is a living plot that cannot be tended in batch. Each key receives one quill bound to a unique soil coordinate and 18 irrigation ticks over 48 hours. Tick k equals H(epoch seed, plot, k), revealed only 90 seconds prior; a soil-hash signed by that quill must land in the window or the plot wilts and 90 POA is slashed. A public orchard of 12,000 coordinates rejects a duplicate plot or two receipts from one IP /48 and burns both bonds. New plots germinate on a nursery island at zero weight until they survive three schedules without a wilt.
